title: Add Pollinations for MIT App Inventor to build
author: pollinations-ai[bot]

gist.summary: Added @Drjacky’s Pollinations for MIT App Inventor to the app catalog and README showcase. The Android project provides a non-visible App Inventor extension (.aix) and a sample project (.aia) for adding Pollinations to apps; Kodular, Niotron, and Android Builder also accept the extension.
